description: This Java source file defines the AllocationsEditor class, which implements a file editor for visualizing allocation data within the Android Studio IDE. It handles parsing allocation files asynchronously, manages UI components, and integrates with IDE features.

classes.name: AllocationsEditor
classes.description: A file editor class for displaying and parsing allocation data in Android Studio.
